artboards.title: A · Editor, same page plus a bar

annotations.text:
A · Quiet editorial
Closest to the essays you named, but refined: warm paper, one serif, thin rules, a small colour per author. The page stays out of the writing's way.
Tradeoff: the quietest of the three. Its personality has to come from the essays.

B · Broadsheet
A journal masthead, display headlines, two columns, so a reply can sit beside what it answers. The dueling is visible from the front page.
Tradeoff: louder, more chrome, and further from the plainness you liked.

C · Austere
Monospace chrome, ISO dates, dotted rules, black on white. The plainness of a developer's blog, made deliberate.
Tradeoff: reads as a tech blog before it reads as a book blog.
Essay page and editor, shown in A. The editor is the essay page with a bar on top: same fonts, same width, footnotes already in the margin. Whichever direction you pick, these two follow it.
